title: 1 Peter Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on 1 Peter 4: living for the will of God, earnest love, and suffering as a Christian.

questions.text: For what should they live the rest of their time in the flesh?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says they should no longer live for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

answers.text: For the peace of the city

questions.text: Whose desire had they spent enough of their past time doing?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says they have spent enough of their past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, walking in lewdness, lusts and drunken binges.

questions.text: To whom will those who blaspheme give account, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says they will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

answers.text: To the elders of the assembly
To the governors of the nations
To him who judges the living and the dead

questions.text: What does verse 7 say is near?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says: but the end of all things is near; therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

questions.text: What does verse 8 say that love does?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says: above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

answers.text: It covers a multitude of sins

questions.text: How are they to be hospitable to one another?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says: be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

questions.text: What rests on them when they are insulted for the name of Christ?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says that if you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.

answers.text: The Spirit of glory and of God

questions.text: Which of these is named in verse 15 as a way they should not suffer?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says: let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men's matters.

answers.text: As a servant of a wicked master
As a stranger among the nations
As a partaker of Christ's sufferings
As a meddler in other men's matters

questions.text: Where has the time come for judgment to begin, according to verse 17?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says that the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God.

answers.text: With the kings of the earth
With the mockers of the last days

questions.text: To whom should those who suffer according to God's will entrust their souls?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 says they should entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.

answers.text: To the prayers of the elders
To him, as to a faithful Creator
To the judges of the city
To the care of the brotherhood
